title: Viterbi Trellis (Best Path)
style: boom bap hip hop, 90 bpm, dusty MPC drums, jazzy upright bass, vinyl crackle, trellis-like piano arpeggio stepping forward in time, vocoder hook, observation-state Rhodes chords, smart confident delivery, 336 hz subharmonic under the kick, late-night thinking-cap mood
lyrics:
[Intro]
Every state remembers the best way it got here
That's the trick, that's the trellis, that's the gear

[Verse 1]
T states wide and N words long
Brute force runs an exponential song
N to the T — the universe ends
Before you finish picking parts of speech, my friends
Viterbi cuts it down to T times N squared
One column at a time, no path is ever shared
Delta of t, delta of t minus one
Times the transition, times the emission, done

[Hook]
Best path — back-pointer — best path — back
Dynamic programming on the open track
Best path — back-pointer — best path — back
Three-three-six, the trellis don't crack

[Verse 2]
Trigram smoothing, lambda one two three
Linear interpolation, set the model free
Unknown word? Suffix tree got the call
Capitalization feature, catch them all
Ninety-six point four six on the WSJ
That's the TnT tagger doing work today

[Hook]
Best path — back-pointer — best path — back
Dynamic programming on the open track
Best path — back-pointer — best path — back
Three-three-six, the trellis don't crack

[Outro]
Don't recompute what you already know
Let the back-pointers tell you where to go
